items.title: Haywood Hillyer Interview, 1958-05-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, the Sturges and I'm in, we, we, uh, hire, to call it jazz bands.

ctx.x: Uh, what about now, at, uh, at parties such as fraternity parties, in fact, do you tend to hire jazz bands or what?
Well, the Sturges and I'm in, we, we, uh, hire, to call it jazz bands. Mm-hmm. White jazz bands are popular, I think. Yeah.
Well, uh, these are, uh, a, a, a jazz bands and not rock and roll bands, huh? Not rock and roll, no. Mostly Dixie Lane jazz bands.
